text:
Maria G.: Heads up — received a late batch from HW partner (edge-collector v1.3). ~15k usage lines arrived 3 days late and produced negative deltas in the ledger. Thinking we need a formal grace-window + retro-credit policy. cc @Josh H. @Kevin D. :thinking_face:

Partners Bot: Automated: webhook delivered 2026-03-18T08:12Z, id=abc123, size=15234. Processing queued.

Josh H.: Can you paste a sample payload? want to check idempotency keys and event timestamps.

Maria G.: here's a redacted snippet from their batch:```json
{
  "partner_id":"edgeco",
  "batch_id":"batch-20260315-01",
  "events":[{
    "id":"evt-7c8",
    "usage_ts":"2026-03-15T02:12:09Z",
    "units":1200
  }],
  "signature":"REDACTED",
  "original_sent_ts":"2026-03-18T07:59:00Z"
}
```

Kevin D.: They backfilled older usage (usage_ts well before delivery). If there's no replay_id/original_batch_ts we can't safely auto-apply beyond a small window. Proposal: 7-day grace window for non-fraud backfills -> auto-apply with ledger tag `partner_retro`; hold anything older for manual reconciliation. Also require dedupe by replay_id.

Susan L.: Ops + Billing note: auto-credits must be traceable for invoicing. Proposed thresholds: auto-credit if delay <72h; for 72h-14d partner must supply signed justification + audit CSV; >14d needs finance approval and legal sign-off. Also ensure entitlement TTL so customers don't see sudden access drops.

Maria G.: I agree. Also request we update the webhook contract to include `replay_id` and `original_sent_ts` and a `correction_reason` enum so partners can flag backfills vs corrections.

Josh H.: Action items: 1) Eng to implement replay_id dedupe and mark entries with `retro_flag`. 2) Policy doc: auto-credit <72h, 72h-14d manual approve with evidence, >14d reject/finance review. 3) Reconcile job to emit daily backfill report and tag ledger entries. I'll open a PR for the runtime changes.

Partners Bot: Created ticket PRJ-4587 - "partner-metering-retro-credit-policy" assigned to Josh H., due 2026-03-24.

Maria G.: Thanks — I'll draft the partner bulletin and updated webhook spec and send to HW + marketplace contacts. Also will include sample CSV layout and evidence checklist.

Kevin D.: One more ask: surface metrics in Console: % backfill events, avg arrival delay, credits issued per partner. That will help partner ops and finance.

Susan L.: :thumbsup: Finance is OK with these thresholds pending the PR and the first reconciliation report.

Josh H.: I'll post the PR link here when ready and wire up the daily report to the partnerships channel for the first run.

Maria G.: Great — thanks everyone. If no objections, we'll go with the thresholds above and start outreach tomorrow. :rocket:
